task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of flight CA1234, then prepare a booking request for John Doe in economy using those flight details. After that, get the weather for Paris, check the checking account status for user_001, look up the USD to EUR exchange rate, and then create a backup of /workspace/project_a named backup_2025_06 and send me an in-app medium-priority alert about it.
